The decisive mistake was made by DataVerification_Expert at step 3. It used a hand-picked "dummy list" of eateries (Ballo at Foxwoods, and places in New London and Niantic) rather than the actual closest eateries to the park. It also relied on a brittle string-matching check for "11:00 PM". As a result, nearby fast-food options such as McDonald's were never examined, and the search was steered toward restaurants far from the park.
